item_short_desc: Rothco’s Woodland Camo Backpack offers convince, comfort and utility, all without sacrificing style.
description: Rothco’s Woodland Camo Backpack offers convince, comfort and utility, all without sacrificing style. The backpack’s main, spacious zippered compartment, and 3 smaller zippered compartments offer ample storage space for your gear. Dual elastic side pouches on this gear bag are great for storing smaller items with quick access, including a water bottle and much more. The shoulder straps feature multiple MOLLE strips and a D-ring on each for attaching gear. The padded and adjustable shoulder straps on this tactical backpack are designed for a comfortable carry. The military backpack features cinch straps fastened by metal buckles aid in stability, keeping your belongings in place. A top carry handle on this backpack offers an additional carrying option and it is constructed with a sturdy polyester material for long-term durability.
